title: Security Policy
desc: Supported versions and how to report vulnerabilities.
lede: Found a security issue? Report it privately. Here's how, and what to expect.
body:
At a glance
  • Supported versions.
  • Private reporting.
  • Response expectations.

Reporting

Report vulnerabilities privately rather than in public issues, so they can be fixed before disclosure.

Scope & response

Supported versions receive fixes, and reports get an acknowledgement and a path to resolution. Path handling is treated as a security surface — see Paths & Security.
